name: visual-seo-schema-suite
description: Bulk alt-text, meta descriptions, WCAG contrast audits, SVG minification and JSON-LD schema building for Framer and Webflow from one shared React + TypeScript core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vss/framer-plugin && npm run build -w @vss/webflow-extension && npm run build -w @vss/playground
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:e2e -w @vss/framer-plugin && npm run build:e2e -w @vss/webflow-extension && npm run build -w @vss/playground
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
